svg.title: Academy, feedback learning, and external evaluation
svg.text: Academy, feedback learning, and external evaluation

g.text: Pilot: verify task/deployment contracts and freeze the learning protocol
At least two tasks, one student backend; record B0 data, training recipe and checkpoint
Verify expert, real embodiment and registration; pilot costs determine rounds, chains and budgets
E1 · Academy facilities: controllable practice, supervision reliability and cost
Reuse main-study logs: timing, tracking, resets, expert yield, label consistency and recovery
One task: native AM-Bench B1 vs academy B1, with matched fixed workflow and budget
E2 · Multi-round feedback learning: does the complete loop beat a fixed workflow?
Main: B0 frozen initial policy | B1 fixed coverage collection/training | AirSpark complete loop
Shared facilities, expert, training and gate; same intervention schedule, caps and paired seeds
Select one plan, collect/train once, then compare with the parent; analyze complete learning chains
Representative-task attribution: fixed process plan, rule revision, current and historical feedback
E3 · Frozen student: native AM-Bench
Unmodified task, robot, action and scoring
B0 / B1 / complete AirSpark
Change from B0 and matched-budget contrasts
Contract mismatch: report a derived setting
E3 · Frozen student: physical robot
Real scan, 3DGS and explicit physics registration
Audit embodiment/deployment before fixing scope
Separate corresponding and held-out conditions
No runtime Mentor correction

svg.text: Sealed and final physical tests never feed back; study scale and quantitative outcomes remain unverified
